Query latest measurements
func:
msg.query = `SELECT
  m.ts,
  c.code AS component_code,
  c.name AS component_name,
  v.code AS variable_code,
  v.name AS variable_name,
  m.value,
  m.quality
FROM measurement m
JOIN component c ON c.id = m.component_id
JOIN variable_catalog v ON v.id = m.variable_id
ORDER BY m.ts DESC
LIMIT 10;`;
return msg;

name: Build measurements JSON
Query latest commands
func:
msg.query = `SELECT
  cmd.ts,
  c.code AS component_code,
  c.name AS component_name,
  cmd.command,
  cmd.value,
  cmd.status
FROM command cmd
JOIN component c ON c.id = cmd.component_id
ORDER BY cmd.ts DESC
LIMIT 10;`;
return msg;

name: Build commands JSON
Query latest alarms
func:
msg.query = `SELECT
  a.ts,
  c.code AS component_code,
  c.name AS component_name,
  a.severity,
  a.code AS alarm_code,
  a.message
FROM alarm a
JOIN component c ON c.id = a.component_id
ORDER BY a.ts DESC
LIMIT 10;`;
return msg;
